## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what changes for the user.

## Validation

List the checks you ran, relevant regression coverage, and any checks skipped with the reason. Use disposable fixtures and redact private data from screenshots or logs.

## Related issue

Link the issue or discussion when relevant. Use `Closes #123` only when this PR resolves that issue.

## Compatibility

Mention user-visible changes, workspace migrations, new dependencies, or breaking changes. Add your own screenshots for UI changes and describe keyboard access. Read CONTRIBUTING.md before requesting review.
